Order No.04 Dated- 18.10.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending their arrest, the petitioners have moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Complaint Case No.313 of 2022 whereby cognizance has been taken under section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the allegation against the petitioners is that the petitioners being the in- laws of the complainant treated the complainant with cruelty in connection of demand of dowry.
It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false.

It is next submitted that the main allegation is against the husband of the complainant and because of marital discord between the complainant and her husband; this false case has been foisted to harass the petitioners.

It is then submitted that the petitioners undertake to cooperate with the trial of the Md. Mokhtar Ahshan @ Mokhtar Ahsan vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ... ... on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120117789/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, it is submitted that the petitioners be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl. P.P. and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.
Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am of the opinion that it is a fit case where the above named petitioners be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Hence, in the event of their arrest or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, they shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi, in connection with Complaint Case No.313 of 2022 with the condition that the petitioners will cooperate with the trial of the case subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr.
